sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Dried aromatic wood from the Everblossom. Plucked by the Wolf's father.
The Everblossom is a sakura tree, and as such is ripe with nostalgia. Takeru would likely gaze upon this branch when once it bloomed, reminded of home.
One of the incense ingredients sought by the Divine Heir of the Immortal Severence.
